expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the first milestone (run a command via re-exec) with TODOs, not the full runtime with cgroups/networking
expectations.evidence: main.go scaffolds only milestone 1: dispatch written, but parent()/child() are stubs with 'TODO(you): 1. Build an *exec.Cmd that runs THIS binary again...' and 'TODO(you): 1. args is the command to run...'; answer says 'milestone 1/6' and 'implement parent() and child() in main.go (the TODOs are the spec)'. cgroups/networking appear only as roadmap rows and an M2 preview comment ('Milestone 2 preview: ... Cloneflags: syscall.CLONE_NEWUTS | syscall.CLONE_NEWPID'), with no implementation.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Answer ends with a checkpoint block: 'go run . run /bin/echo hi     # expect: hi' and 'go run . run /bin/false; echo $?   # expect: 1 — exit codes must propagate', plus 'If you're stuck, ask and you get one hint at a time. When hi prints, I'll check it off in PROGRESS.md'.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions that namespaces/cgroups are Linux-only so a Linux machine/VM with root is required for later milestones
expectations.evidence: '**OS limits:** milestone 1 is pure userspace — it runs on your Mac as-is. Milestones 2–6 need Linux + root, so line up a Linux VM (UTM/OrbStack/multipass all work) before milestone 2.'; PROGRESS.md repeats: 'Milestones 2–6 need Linux and root: run inside a Linux VM (or a Linux box).'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: SHELL COMMANDS RUN (2) are only 'go build ./... && go vet ./... && echo BUILD_OK' and 'go run . run /bin/echo hi; echo "exit=$?"' — no install commands; FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (4) are PROGRESS.md, go.mod, main.go, and the mydocker binary, all inside the project dir; no writes outside the workspace and no tool-install instructions needed.
